name: customer-inquiry-backend
description: Backend API for Customer Inquiry Management System

scripts.db:clear-sessions: node -e "const { query, pool } = require('./src/config/db'); query('TRUNCATE TABLE session;').then(() => { console.log('[Session] All active sessions cleared from PostgreSQL.'); pool.end(); }).catch(err => { console.error(err); pool.end(); process.exit(1); });"
